Gender adalah konsep yang mengacu pada pembedaan peran dan

tanggungjawab laki-laki dan perempuan yang terjadi akibat dari dan dapat berubah oleh keadaan sosial dan budaya masyarakat.

untuk memperoleh kesempatan dan hak-haknya sebagai manusia agar mampu berperan dan berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan politik, ekonomi, sosial budaya, pertahanan dan keamanan, dan kesamaan dalam menikmati hasil pembangunan.

15. Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan berdasarkan pembedaan jenis kelamin yang mengakibatkan, atau bisa mengakibatkan penderitaan fisik, psikis dan/atau seksual terhadap perempuan, termasuk ancaman, pemaksaan atau perampasan kebebasan secara sewenang wenang baik yang teijadi di ranah publik maupun di ranah kehidupan pribadi.
16. Kekerasan Berbasis Gender yang selanjutnya disingkat KBG adalah pelanggaran Hak Asasi Manusia yang disebabkan oleh peran pelabelan berdasarkan jenis kelamin, yang mengingkari martabat manusia dan hak atas diri sendiri yang berdampak pada, atau berdampak menyerupai fisik, psikis, dan seksual atau membawa penderitaan bagi perempuan dan anak termasuk di dalamnya segala bentuk tindakan, paksaan, kesewenang wenangan serta merampas kemerdekaan, yang dilakukan di ranah publik maupun kehidupan pribadi.
17. Bencana adalah peristiwa atau rangkaian peristiwa yang mengancam dan mengganggu kehidupan dan penghidupan masyarakat yang disebabkan baik oleh faktor alam dan/atau faktor nonalam maupun faktor manusia sehingga mengakibatkan timbulnya korban jiwa manusia, kerusakan lingkungan, kerugian harta benda, dan dampak psikologis.
18. Keluarga adalah orang yang mempunyai hubungan darah dalam garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah dan garis menyamping sampai derajat ketiga, atau yang mempunyai hubungan perkawinan, atau orang yang menjadi tanggungan perempuan.
19. Lanjut Usia adalah seseorang yang telah mencapai usia 60 (enam puluh) tahun keatas.
20. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan, keluarga, kelompok, dan organisasi sosial dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
21. Penyandang Disabilitas adalah setiap orang yang mengalami keterbatasan fisik, intelektual, mental, dan/atau sensorik dalam jangka waktu lama yang dalam berinteraksi dengan lingkungan dapat mengalami hambatan dan kesulitan untuk berpartisipasi secara penuh dan efektif dengan warga negara lainnya berdasarkan kesamaan hak.
22. Tenaga Keija adalah setiap orang yang mampu melakukan pekeijaan guna menghasilkan barang dan/atau jasa baik untuk memenuhi kebutuhan sendiri maupun untuk Masyarakat.
23. Pekeija/Buruh adalah setiap orang yang bekeija dengan menerima upah atau imbalan dalam bentuk lain.
24. Sistem Data dan Informasi adalah pengumpulan, pengelolaan, dan pemanfaatan data Perempuan yang diperlukan dalam Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan.
translated_text:
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Boyolali Regency.
2. Regional Government is the administration of governmental affairs by the regional government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
3. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administrator who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
4. Regent...................
-3-
4. Regent is the Regent of Boyolali.
5. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of the Regional Government administrator.
6. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and DPRD in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the Region.
7. Regional Technical Implementation Unit is a technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, exploitation, discrimination, who require special protection, and other problems.
8. Integrated Service Center is a non-structural institution that coordinates the implementation of an integrated service system for women victims.
9. Human Rights are a set of rights inherent in the nature and existence of humans as creatures of God Almighty and are His gift that must be respected, upheld and protected by the state, law, government, and every person for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity and worth.
10. Women's Empowerment is all efforts to improve physical, mental spiritual, social capacity, knowledge and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
11. Women's Protection is all efforts aimed at protecting and providing a sense of security to women as well as fulfilling their rights through consistent, structured, and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
12. Discrimination is any restriction, harassment or exclusion that is directly or indirectly based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, group, class, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs, which results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of Human Rights and basic freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.
13. Gender is a concept that refers to the differentiation of roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
14. Gender Equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so that they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, defense and security activities, and equality in enjoying the results of development.
15. Violence....................
-4-
15. Violence Against Women is any action based on gender differentiation that results in, or could result in physical, psychological and/or sexual suffering to women, including threats, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom whether occurring in the public sphere or in the sphere of private life.
16. Gender-Based Violence hereinafter abbreviated as KBG is a violation of Human Rights caused by gender role labeling based on gender, which denies human dignity and the right to self that has an impact on, or has an impact similar to physical, psychological, and sexual or brings suffering to women and children including all forms of actions, coercion, arbitrariness and deprivation of freedom, carried out in the public sphere or private life.
17. Disaster is an event or series of events that threaten and disrupt the life and livelihood of the community caused by natural and/or non-natural factors as well as human factors resulting in human casualties, environmental damage, property losses, and psychological impacts.
18. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and a collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman.
19. Elderly is a person who has reached the age of 60 (sixty) years and above.
20. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
21. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental, and/or sensory limitations in the long term who in interacting with the environment may experience obstacles and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.
22. Labor Force is every person who is capable of performing work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for the Community.
23. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or remuneration in other forms.
24. Data and Information System is the collection, management, and utilization of Women's data needed in the Implementation of Women's Protection and Empowerment.

text:
Pasal 3
Perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan bertujuan untuk: a. meningkatkan partisipasi perempuan dalam proses pembangunan; b. meningkatkan kualitas hidup perempuan;
c. memberikan jaminan kepada perempuan dalam pemenuhan hak sebagai manusia; dan
d. memberikan rasa aman dengan meningkatkan perlindungan kepada perempuan dari berbagai tindak kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 3
The Protection and Empowerment of Women aims to: a. increase the participation of women in the development process; b. improve the quality of life of women;
c. provide guarantees to women in the fulfillment of rights as human beings; and
d. provide a sense of security by increasing protection for women from various acts of violence.

text:
Pasal 8
(1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan Lanjut Usia dalam rangka memperpanjang usia harapan hidup agar dapat melaksanakan fungsi sosialnya dan berperan aktif secara wajar dalam kehidupan sosialnya.
(2) Perempuan Lanjut Usia sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan hak Perlindungan atas:
a. jaminan keberlangsungan dan pengembangan diri pribadi; b. partisipasi di bidang pendidikan, kesehatan, pekerjaan, politik, seni dan budaya serta pemanfaatan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi; c. aksesibilitas informasi, bantuan hukum, mobilitas, layanan sosial, fasilitas umum, dan bangunan; dan
d. upaya intervensi dini termasuk pengobatan dan rehabilitasi untuk peningkatan fungsi dan kapasitasnya.
translated_text:
Article 8
(1) The implementation of protection for elderly women in the context of extending life expectancy so that they can carry out their social functions and play an active role naturally in their social life.
(2) Elderly women as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive the right to Protection for:
a. guarantee of continuity and personal self-development; b. participation in the fields of education, health, employment, politics, arts and culture as well as the utilization of information and communication technology; c. accessibility to information, legal assistance, mobility, social services, public facilities, and buildings; and
d. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation to improve their functions and capacity.

Pasal 9
(1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan Penyandang Disabilitas dalam rangka memberikan perlindungan dan pencegahan terhadap bentuk Diskriminasi antara lain bebas dari perlakuan kejam, tidak manusiawi, merendahkan martabat manusia dan bebas dari eksploitasi.
(2) Perempuan Penyandang Disabilitas sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan hak perlindungan atas:
a. jaminan keberlangsungan dan pengembangan diri pribadi; b. partisipasi di bidang pendidikan, kesehatan, pekeijaan, politik, olahraga, seni dan budaya serta pemanfaatan teknologi informasi dan komunikasi;
c. aksesibilitas informasi, bantuan hukum, mobilitas, layanan sosial; dan d. upaya intervensi dini termasuk pengobatan dan rehabilitasi untuk peningkatan fungsi dan kapasitasnya.
translated_text:
Article 9
(1) The implementation of protection for women with Disabilities in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of Discrimination includes, among others, freedom from cruel, inhuman treatment, degrading human dignity and freedom from exploitation.
(2) Women with Disabilities as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive the right to protection for:
a. guarantee of continuity and personal self-development; b. participation in the fields of education, health, employment, politics, sports, arts and culture as well as utilization of information and communication technology;
c. accessibility of information, legal aid, mobility, social services; and d. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation to improve their function and capacity.

text:
Pasal 12
(1) Pelaksanaaan perlindungan bagi perempuan penyangga ekonomi Keluarga dalam rangka memberikan perlindungan dan pencegahan terhadap bentuk Diskriminasi, stigma negatif dan pemberdayaan ekonomi bagi perempuan penyangga ekonomi Keluarga.
(2) Perempuan penyangga ekonomi Keluarga sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan hak perlindungan atas:
a. tindakan Diskriminasi dan upaya pelemahan fungsi perempuan sebagai penyangga ekonomi Keluarga;
b. penguatan kemampuan dan pengakuan sebagai penyangga ekonomi Keluarga di lingkungannya; dan
c. aksesibilitas terhadap lembaga ekonomi dan keuangan.
translated_text:
Article 12
(1) The implementation of protection for women as family economic pillars is in the context of providing protection and prevention against forms of Discrimination, negative stigma and economic empowerment for women as family economic pillars.
(2) Women as family economic pillars as referred to in paragraph (1) shall receive the right to protection from:
a. acts of Discrimination and efforts to weaken the function of women as family economic pillars;
b. strengthening of capacity and recognition as family economic pillars in their environment; and
c. accessibility to economic and financial institutions.

text:

Perempuan Mantan Warga Binaan Lembaga Pemasyarakatan Pasal 13 (1) Pelaksanaan perlindungan bagi perempuan mantan warga binaan lembaga pemasyarakatan dalam rangka memberikan perlindungan dari hambatan untuk menyesuaikan diri dalam kehidupan Masyarakat, sehingga dapat melaksanakan kehidupan secara normal.
(2) Perempuan mantan warga binaan lembaga pemasyarakatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) mendapatkan perlindungan atas:
a. rehabilitasi sosial dan reintegrasi sosial; dan
b. kesempatan memperoleh pengetahuan dan keterampilan untuk meningkatkan status ekonomi.
translated_text:
Part Eight
Women Former Inmates of Correctional Institutions Article 13 (1) The implementation of protection for women former inmates of correctional institutions is aimed at providing protection from obstacles to adjusting themselves in community life, so that they can carry out life normally.
(2) Women former inmates of correctional institutions as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection in the form of:
a. social rehabilitation and social reintegration; and
b. opportunities to obtain knowledge and skills to improve economic status.

text:
Pasal 19
Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang politik dan pemerintahan meliputi: (1)
a. pelibatan perempuan dalam pengambilan keputusan di bidang pembangunan dan kehidupan di berbagai tingkatan;
b. pemberian kesempatan bagi perempuan untuk menduduki jabatan publik;
c. partisipasi dalam pemilihan umum; dan
d. pengembangan diri melalui organisasi untuk berserikat, berkumpul, dan mengeluarkan pendapat.
Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang p>olitik dan pemerintahan (2) sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan pemndang-undangan.
Pemerintah Daerah memberikan jaminan kepada perempuan untuk (3) mempunyai hak memilih dan/atau dipilih dalam pemilihan umum, pemilihan kepala daerah, pemilihan kepala desa dan/atau pemilihan jabatan politik lainnya berdasarkan persamaan hak melalui pemungutan suara yang langsung, umum, bebas, rahasia, jujur dan adil menurut ketentuan peraturan pemndang-undangan.
(4) Pemerintah Daerah................
-13- (4) Pemerintah Daerah memberikan kesempatan pada perempuan untuk diangkat sebagai pejabat Pemerintah Daerah dan menempati posisi strategis dalam Pemerintahan Daerah.
(5) Pemerintah Daerah dan/atau partai politik dapat memberikan pendidikan politik bagi perempuan.
translated_text:
Article 19
Empowerment of Women in the field of politics and government includes: (1)
a. involvement of women in decision-making in the field of development and life at various levels;
b. provision of opportunities for women to hold public office;
c. participation in general elections; and
d. self-development through organizations to associate, assemble, and express opinions.
Empowerment of Women in the field of politics and government (2) as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
Regional Government provides guarantees to women to (3) have the right to vote and/or be elected in general elections, regional head elections, village head elections and/or other political office elections based on equal rights through direct, general, free, secret, honest and fair voting according to the provisions of laws and regulations.
(4) Regional Government................
-13- (4) Regional Government provides opportunities for women to be appointed as Regional Government officials and occupy strategic positions in Regional Government.
(5) Regional Government and/or political parties may provide political education for women.

a. peningkatan kesadaran dan pengetahuan di bidang hukum melalui layanan komunikasi, informasi, dan edukasi; dan
b. fasilitasi akses dan layanan konsultasi hukum.
(2) Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang hukum sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) Women's Empowerment in the field of law includes:
a. increasing awareness and knowledge in the field of law through communication, information, and education services; and
b. facilitation of access and legal consultation services.
(2) Women's Empowerment in the field of law as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Bagian Keenam
Bidang Pendidikan
translated_text:
Sixth Part
Education Sector

text:
Pasal 21
(1) Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang pendidikan melalui penyelenggaraan pendidikan formal dan nonformal bagi perempuan di Daerah. (2) Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang pendidikan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan perempuan. (3) Pendidikan nonformal sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi pendidikan Pemberdayaan Perempuan, pendidikan keterampilan, dan pelatihan kerja.
(4) Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang pendidikan dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 21
(1) Women's Empowerment in the field of education through the implementation of formal and nonformal education for women in the Region. (2) Women's Empowerment in the field of education as referred to in paragraph (1) aims to improve the capabilities of women. (3) Nonformal education as referred to in paragraph (1) includes Women's Empowerment education, skills education, and job training.
(4) Women's Empowerment in the field of education is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Bidang Kesehatan

Seventh Part
Health Sector

text:
Pasal 22
(1) Perempuan mempunyai hak untuk mendapatkan pelayanan kesehatan guna menjalani kehidupan reproduksi dan kehidupan seksual yang sehat, aman, serta bebas dari paksaan dan/atau kekerasan.
(2) Pelayanan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: a. pelayanan kesehatan masa sebelum hamil, hamil, persalinan, dan sesudah melahirkan;
b. pengaturan....................
-14-
b. pengaturan kehamilan, pelayanan kontrasepsi, dan kesehatan seksual; dan
c. pelayanan kesehatan reproduksi.
Pelayanan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan (3) melalui pendekatan promotif, preventif, kuratif, dan rehabilitatif.
translated_text:
Article 22
(1) Women have the right to obtain health services in order to undergo reproductive life and sexual life that is healthy, safe, and free from coercion and/or violence.
(2) Health services as referred to in paragraph (1) include: a. health services for the period before pregnancy, during pregnancy, childbirth, and after giving birth;
b. regulation....................
-14-
b. regulation of pregnancy, contraceptive services, and sexual health; and
c. reproductive health services.
(3) Health services as referred to in paragraph (1) are implemented through promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative approaches.

text:

Bidang Ketenagakeijaan
translated_text:
Eighth Part
Employment Sector

text:
Pasal 23
(1) Perempuan memiliki kesempatan yang sama tanpa Diskriminasi untuk memperoleh pekerjaan.
(2) Pemberi keija yang menggunakan Tenaga Keija perempuan, wajib memberikan perlindungan yang mencakup kesejahteraan, keselamatan, dan kesehatan.
translated_text:
Article 23
(1) Women have equal opportunities without Discrimination to obtain employment.
(2) Employers who employ female Workers, are obligated to provide protection that includes welfare, safety, and health.

Pasal 24

(2) Pemerintah Daerah memberikan hak atasjaminan sosial bagi perempuan penyandang masalah sosial.
(3) Tanggung jawab penyediaan fasilitas pembinaan bagi perempuan penyandang masalah sosial berada dibawah Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
translated_text:
Article 24
(1) The Regional Government is responsible for providing guidance facilities for women with social problems.
(2) The Regional Government provides rights to social security for women with social problems.
(3) The responsibility for providing guidance facilities for women with social problems is under the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

text:
BAB V
KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB PEMERINTAH DAERAH Pasal 25 (1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab terhadap perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan.
(2) Upaya perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), meliputi:
a. penetapan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan;
b. penetapan pedoman pelaksanaan;
c. penyelenggaraan layanan; dan
d. koordinasi kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan.
(3) Upaya...................
-15- (3) Upaya perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) dilakukan secara terpadu sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER V
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF REGIONAL GOVERNMENT Article 25 (1) The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility for the protection and Empowerment of Women.
(2) The efforts for protection and Empowerment of Women as referred to in paragraph (1), include:
a. determination of policies, programs, and activities;
b. determination of implementation guidelines;
c. provision of services; and
d. coordination of policies, programs, and activities.
(3) The efforts...................
-15- (3) The efforts for protection and Empowerment of Women as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be carried out in an integrated manner in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
BAB VI
STRATEGI PERLINDUNGAN DAN PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN Pasal 26 (1) Perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dilaksanakan dengan mengintegrasikan pengarusutamaan Gender dan data terpilah Gender secara terpadu berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
(2) Perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dikoordinasikan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VI
STRATEGY FOR THE PROTECTION AND EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN Article 26 (1) The Protection and Empowerment of Women is implemented by integrating Gender mainstreaming and Gender-disaggregated data in an integrated manner based on the provisions of laws and regulations.
(2) The Protection and Empowerment of Women is coordinated by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

text:
BAB VII
MEKANISME PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN DAN
PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN
Pasal 27
Mekanisme penyelenggaraan Perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dilakukan melalui tahapan:
a. perumusan kebijakan perencanaan program dan kegiatan; b. penganggaran program dan kegiatan;
c. pelaksanaan program dan kegiatan; dan
d. monitoring, evaluasi, dan pelaporan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
MECHANISM FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF WOMEN'S PROTECTION AND
EMPOWERMENT
Article 27
The mechanism for the implementation of Women's Protection and Empowerment is carried out through the following stages:
a. formulation of policy for program and activity planning; b. budgeting of programs and activities;
c. implementation of programs and activities; and
d. monitoring, evaluation, and reporting.

text:
Pasal 28
(1) Perumusan kebijakan perencanaan program dan kegiatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 27 huruf a, dilaksanakan terdiri atas: a. pemetaan, pengumpulan, pengolahan dan penyajian data; b. koordinasi dan sinkronisasi penyusunan perencanaan program dan kegiatan dengan Perangkat Daerah terkait; dan
c. penetapan program dan kegiatan dalam dokumen perencanaan. (2) Perumusan kebijakan perencanaan program dan kegiatan diatur lebih lanjut dalam standar pelayanan minimal dan standar operasional prosedur.
(3) Perumusan................
-16- (3) Perumusan kebijakan perencanaan program dan kegiatan penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan, dikoordinasikan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang perencanaan.
(4) Penganggaran program dan kegiatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 27 huruf b, dilaksanakan melalui kebijakan umum anggaran yang dituangkan dalam anggaran pendapatan dam belanja Daerah.
(5) Pelaksanaan program dan kegiatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 27 huruf c, dilaksanakan terdiri atas:
a. pelaksanaan program dan kegiatan yang tertuang dalam dokumen anggaran satuan kerja Perangkat Daerah;
b. koordinasi dan sinkronisasi pelaksanaan program kegiatan dengan Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
(6) Pelaksanaan monitoring, evaluasi, dan pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 27 huruf d, dilaksanakan terdiri atas:
a. melakukan monitoring dan evaluasi secara berkala terhadap pelaksanaan program dan kegiatan yang telah dilaksanakan; b. membuat laporan secara berkala; dan
c. hasil evaluasi sebagai bahan masukan bagi penyusunan kebijakan, program, dan kegiatan tahun berikutnya.
translated_text:
Article 28
(1) The formulation of policy for program and activity planning as referred to in Article 27 letter a, is implemented consisting of: a. mapping, collection, processing and presentation of data; b. coordination and synchronization of the preparation of program and activity planning with related Regional Apparatus; and
c. determination of programs and activities in planning documents. (2) The formulation of policy for program and activity planning is further regulated in minimum service standards and standard operating procedures.
(3) The formulation................
-16- (3) The formulation of policy for program and activity planning for the implementation of protection and Empowerment of Women, is coordinated by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of planning.
(4) The budgeting of programs and activities as referred to in Article 27 letter b, is implemented through general budget policy which is set forth in the Regional revenue and expenditure budget.
(5) The implementation of programs and activities as referred to in Article 27 letter c, is implemented consisting of:
a. implementation of programs and activities contained in the budget document of the Regional Apparatus work unit;
b. coordination and synchronization of program and activity implementation with Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and child protection.
(6) The implementation of monitoring, evaluation, and reporting as referred to in Article 27 letter d, is implemented consisting of:
a. conducting monitoring and evaluation periodically on the implementation of programs and activities that have been implemented; b. making reports periodically; and
c. evaluation results as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the following year.

text:
BAB VIII
KELEMBAGAAN
Pasal 29
(1) Dalam rangka penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan Pemerintah Daerah membentuk:
a. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu; dan
b. Unit Pelaksama Teknis Daerah.
(2) Dalam penyelenggaraan pelayanan perempuan korban, Pemerintah Daerah membentuk Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu sebagai jejaring pelayanan korban. (3) Pembentukan Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) agar perempuan korban memperoleh pelayanan yang komprehensif, terintegrasi, berkualitas, inklusif dan berkelanjutan.
{4) Pada Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak dibentuk Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah untuk melaksanakan kegiatan teknis operasional dan/atau kegiatan teknis penunjang tertentu pelaksanaan urusan pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
(5) Ketentuan.................
-17- (5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu dan Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS
Article 29
(1) In the context of implementing the protection and Empowerment of Women, the Regional Government shall establish:
a. Integrated Service Center; and
b. Regional Technical Implementation Unit.
(2) In implementing services for women victims, the Regional Government shall establish an Integrated Service Center as a victim service network.
(3) The establishment of the Integrated Service Center as referred to in paragraph (2) is so that women victims obtain comprehensive, integrated, quality, inclusive and sustainable services.
(4) In the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection, a Regional Technical Implementation Unit shall be established to carry out operational technical activities and/or certain supporting technical activities for the implementation of women's empowerment and child protection affairs.
(5) Provisions.................
-17- (5) Further provisions regarding the Integrated Service Center and Regional Technical Implementation Unit shall be regulated by Regent Regulation in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 30
(1) Selain membentuk Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu dan Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 29, Pemerintah Daerah dapat membentuk gugus tugas dan/atau komite aksi Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan.
(2) Gugus tugas dan/atau komite aksi Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dibentuk guna menunjang terlaksananya penyelenggaraan perlindungan kepada Perempuan dari tindak kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 30
(1) In addition to establishing an Integrated Service Center and Regional Technical Implementation Unit as referred to in Article 29, Regional Governments may establish a task force and/or regional action committee for the Protection of Women.
(2) The task force and/or regional action committee for the Protection of Women as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be established to support the implementation of protection for Women from acts of violence.

text:
Pasal 31
(1) Gugus tugas dan/atau komite aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 30 merupakan lembaga koordinatifyang bertugas mengoordinasikan Perlindungan Perempuan, pencegahan dan penanganan perdagangan orang.
(2) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai pembentukan, tugas, dan fungsi gugus tugas dan/atau komite aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dalam Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 31
(1) The task force and/or regional action committee as referred to in Article 30 constitutes a coordinative institution tasked with coordinating the Protection of Women, prevention and handling of trafficking in persons.
(2) Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force and/or regional action committee as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

KOORDINASi DAN KERJASAMA

Koordinasi

Coordination

text:
Pasal 32
Dalam rangka penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan, Pemerintah Daerah melaksanakan koordinasi dengan pemerintah pusat, pemerintah provinsi, pemerintah kabupaten/kota lain, instansi terkait, lembaga penegak hukum, lembaga layanan, lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, lembaga sosial masyarakat, pesantren, organisasi profesi, organisasi bantuan hukum, organisasi kepemudaan, lembaga pengawas penyiaran, media, komunitas, lembaga profesi, dunia usaha serta stakeholderlainnya yang terkait.
translated_text:

In the context of implementing the protection and Empowerment of Women, the Regional Government carries out coordination with the central government, provincial government, other district/city governments, related agencies, law enforcement institutions, service institutions, educational institutions, religious institutions, community social institutions, Islamic boarding schools, professional organizations, legal aid organizations, youth organizations, broadcasting supervisory institutions, media, communities, professional institutions, business sector as well as other related stakeholders.

Cooperation

text:

(2) Keijasama sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 33
(1) In the context of implementing the protection and empowerment of women, the Regional Government may conduct cooperation.
(2) The cooperation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

PENGEMBANGAN SISTEM DATA DAN INFORMASI
Pasal 34

(2) Sistem Data dan Informasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) melibatkan pemerintah, pemerintah provinsi dan instansi vertikal serta pemangku kepentingan.
(3) Data dan informasi p>erUndungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan dipublikasikan kepada Masyarakat dan disampaikan kepada Perangkat Daerah dan instansi yang terkait untuk pengembangan program dan kebijakan Perlindungan Perempuan.
(4) Pengembangan Sistem Data dan Informasi perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan dan menjadi tanggung jawab Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan perlindungan anak dan Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang komunikasi dan informatika.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X
DEVELOPMENT OF DATA AND INFORMATION SYSTEM
Article 34
(1) The Regional Government establishes an integrated and interconnected Data and Information System for the protection and Empowerment of Women.
(2) The Data and Information System as referred to in paragraph (1) involves the government, provincial government and vertical agencies as well as stakeholders.
(3) Data and information on the protection and Empowerment of Women are published to the Community and submitted to Regional Apparatus and related agencies for the development of programs and policies on Women's Protection.
(4) The development of the Data and Information System for the protection and Empowerment of Women as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations and is the responsibility of the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and child protection and the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of communication and informatics.

text:

Pasal 35
(1) Masyarakat dapat berperan serta dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan.
(2) Peran.............
-19- (2) Peran serta Masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat diwujudkan dengan:
a. tindakan memberikan informasi dan/atau melaporkan Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan kepada penegak hukum atau pihak yang berwajib, atau turut serta menangani tindak Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan; dan/atau
b. penyediaan media komunikasi, informasi, dan edukasi tentang pemberdayaan dan pencegahan Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan di dalam Keluarga, Masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan, dan ruang publik.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI

Article 35
(1) The Community may participate in the implementation of protection and Empowerment of Women.
(2) Participation.............
-19- (2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be realized through:
a. actions to provide information and/or report Violence Against Women to law enforcers or authorized parties, or participate in handling acts of Violence Against Women; and/or
b. provision of communication, information, and education media regarding empowerment and prevention of Violence Against Women within the Family, Community, educational institutions, and public spaces.

text:
BAB XII
PENDANAAN
Pasal 36
Pendanaan, pelaksanaan kebijakan, dan program kegiatan f>erlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan bersumber dari Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah dan sumber dana lainnya yang sah dan tidak mengikat.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XII
FUNDING
Article 36
Funding, implementation of policies, and activity programs for the Protection and Empowerment of Women are sourced from the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget and other legitimate and non-binding sources of funds.

text:

PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN
Pasal 37
(1) Bupati berwenang melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan atas penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan.
(2) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dUakukan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan perlindungan anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XIII
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 37
(1) The Regent has the authority to conduct guidance and supervision over the implementation of protection and Empowerment of Women.
(2) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and child protection.

text:
Pasal 39
(1) Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 ayat (2) berupa pemantauan dan evaluasi terhadap penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Daerah.
(2) Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan dengan prinsip profesional, transparan, dan akuntabel.
(3) Masyarakat dapat melakukan pengawasan penyelenggaraan perlindungan dan Pemberdayaan Perempuan yang diselenggarakan di Daerah.
(4) Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) dilakukan dengan mekanisme penyampaian aspirasi kepada Pemerintah Daerah dan/atau DPRD.
translated_text:
Article 39
(1) Supervision as referred to in Article 37 paragraph (2) shall be in the form of monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection and Empowerment of Women in the Region.
(2) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted with professional, transparent, and accountable principles.
(3) The community may conduct supervision of the implementation of protection and Empowerment of Women organized in the Region.
(4) Supervision as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted through a mechanism of conveying aspirations to the Regional Government and/or DPRD.

text:
PENJELASAN
ATAS
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN BOYOLALI
NOMOR TAHUN 2021
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN DAN PEMBERDAYAAN PEREMPUAN
I. UMUM
Negara melalui pemerintah dan Pemerintahan Daerah sesuai kewenangannya bertanggung jawab untuk menghormati, melindungi, dan menjamin hak-hak asasi manusia dari setiap warga negara termasuk perempuan dan anak tanpa diskriminasi, karena perempuan dan anak merupakan bagian dari warga negara Indonesia memiliki hak yang sama dengan orang lain, dan hak perempuan dan anak merupakan hak asasi manusia yang harus dijamin, dilindungi bukan hanya oleh pemerintah tapi juga oleh Pemerintah Daerah.
Walaupun ada jaminan peraturan perundang-undangan yang melindungi warga negara khususnya perempuan namun kasus perempuan semakin bertambah, tidak menurun, karena kasus kekerasan terhadap perempuan seperti fenomena gunung es yaitu kasus yang dilaporkan ke lembaga perlindungan perempuan hanya sebagian kecil dari kasus yang sebenamya. Perempuan korban kekerasan sering merasa ragu atau takut dalam melaporkan kekerasan yang dialaminya, atau ada kendala lainnya seperti sulitnya akses dalam mencapai layanan dan kurangnya informasi tentang hak-hak yang dimiliki karena sebagian besar perempuan korban berasal dari keluarga miskin dan kurang mampu sehingga perlu dilakukan pendampingan, biaya pendampingan, dan konsultasi hukum mahal. Di sisi lain lembaga yang menangani perlindungan perempuan masih kurang, terutama di daerah yang jauh dari pusat kota.
Berbagai bentuk tindak kekerasan, perlakuan salah, eksploitasi, dan penelantaran terhadap Perempuan yang teijadi di Daerah diperlukan adanya upaya strategis dari Pemerintah Daerah guna memberikan perlindungan dan terhadap perempuan.
Selanjutnya dalam rangka mewujudkan kebijakan Daerah untuk menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan Daerah di bidang perlindungan perempuan berdasarkan Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah sebagaimana telah diubah beberapa kali terakhir dengan Undang-Undang Nomor 11 Tahun 2020 tentang Cipta Keija perlu disusun dalam Peraturan Daerah.
Peraturan Daerah ini merupakan wujud konkrit Pemerintah Kabupaten Boyolali dalam memberikan pelindungan dan menjamin terpenuhinya hak asasi Perempuan sesuai dengan tugas dan tanggungjawabnya.

translated_text:
ELUCIDATION
ON
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BOYOLALI REGENCY
NUMBER YEAR 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION AND EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN
I. GENERAL
The State through the government and Regional Government in accordance with their authority is responsible for respecting, protecting, and guaranteeing the human rights of every citizen including women and children without discrimination, because women and children are part of Indonesian citizens who have the same rights as others, and the rights of women and children are human rights that must be guaranteed, protected not only by the government but also by the Regional Government.
Although there are guarantees in laws and regulations that protect citizens, especially women, cases involving women continue to increase, not decrease, because cases of violence against women are like an iceberg phenomenon, namely cases reported to women's protection institutions are only a small part of the actual cases. Women victims of violence often feel hesitant or afraid to report the violence they experience, or there are other obstacles such as difficulty in accessing services and lack of information about their rights because most women victims come from poor and underprivileged families, so they need assistance, assistance costs, and legal consultation is expensive. On the other hand, institutions that handle women's protection are still lacking, especially in areas far from the city center.
Various forms of acts of violence, mistreatment, exploitation, and neglect of Women that occur in the Region require strategic efforts from the Regional Government to provide protection for women.
Furthermore, in order to realize regional policies to administer governmental affairs that are the authority of the Region in the field of women's protection based on Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as has been amended several times most recently by Law Number 11 of 2020 concerning Job Creation, it is necessary to formulate this in a Regional Regulation.
This Regional Regulation is a concrete manifestation of the Boyolali Regency Government in providing protection and guaranteeing the fulfillment of the human rights of Women in accordance with its duties and responsibilities.

Huruf c Yang dimaksud dengan “asas nondiskriminasi” adalah bahwa dalam perlindungan dan pemberdayaan perempuan dilakukan tanpa melihat perbedaan baik dimensi wilayah (daerah Bencana, daerah konflik, daerah perbatasan, daerah tertinggal, daerah terpencil, dan lainnya), dimensi usia (usia produktif, usia lanjut, dan lainnya), dan dimensi khusus (penyandang cacat, tenaga keija, dan lainnya).
Huruf d Yang dimaksud dengan “asas perlindungan korban” adalah bahwa perlindungan dan pemberdayaan perempuan yang dilakukan baik oleh Pemerintah Daerah, badan usaha maupun masyarakat diorientasi pada terlindunginya perempuan sebagai korban.

translated_text:
Article 2
Letter a What is meant by "the principle of respect for Human Rights" is that the protection and empowerment of women is carried out as a manifestation of respect for women's rights as part of Human Rights.
Letter b What is meant by "the principle of justice and Gender Equality" is that in implementing the protection and empowerment of women it is based on justice and equality between men and women.
Letter c What is meant by "the principle of non-discrimination" is that in the protection and empowerment of women it is carried out without regard to differences whether in the dimension of territory (disaster areas, conflict areas, border areas, underdeveloped areas, remote areas, and others), the dimension of age (productive age, elderly age, and others), and special dimensions (persons with disabilities, workers, and others).
Letter d What is meant by "the principle of victim protection" is that the protection and empowerment of women carried out by the Regional Government, business entities or the community is oriented towards the protection of women as victims.
